headline: TRUMP'S TARIFFS 💣🍆 BLUE-BALL 😩 Canada's paper-PUSSY MILL 🏭💦
text:
🚨🚨ATTENTION all you TARIFF-IFIED 🧾😱 FOREST HOES 🌲🍑🚨🚨 the century-old 📜 paper mill 🏭😩 in Témiscaming Quebec 🇨🇦 got SLAMMED 💥🍆 by Trump's 🇺🇸 5️⃣0️⃣% duties 📈😭 forcing an indefinite ⛔ ECONOMIC SHUTDOWN 🛑💦 after trade 🗣️ talks collapsed 🌉💔 leaving its 3️⃣6️⃣0️⃣ throbbing workers 🧑‍🏭🍆 out on partial 🏛️ government relief 📬 cheques 💰😩 while property 🏡 values PLUMMETED 🏠📉 overnight and For Sale 🏷️ signs popped 🌼 up like desperate morning 🌄 wood 🌅🍆‼️ Nadine Suley 🧔‍♀️ and Ronnie Raymond 🧔 are SCREAMING 😱💦 it's not ❌ just a job 💼 it's our HOME 🏡🍑 and these 📌 tariffs feel 🫱 like a PERSONAL 🛡️ ATTACK 🗡️😳 turning their proud 🪵 lumber town 🏘️ into a potential 👻 GHOST ORGY 🍑 of nothing left 👻🕳️

Stéphane Lefebvre 👨 and Mayor Alain Gauthier 🧓 want to buy 🛍️ the mill-FUCKED 😩 plant back 🛒🏭 just like 🔙 in 1️⃣9️⃣7️⃣3️⃣ when workers 👷 took a 1️⃣0️⃣% pay cut 💸 to snatch 🫳 it from American 🦅 hands 🤝🍆 but now they need 📢 Carney's big 📦 stimulus LOAD 💸💦 or serious 🛡️ tariff relief 🩹 to avoid 🚫 getting permanently 🔵 blue-BALLED by the paper-PUSSY 🐱 industry while 🛠️ steel and autos 🚗 get all the C$9️⃣B🇨🇦 attention 😤🚨

PASS 🔁 this on to 6️⃣9️⃣ desperate mill workers 🏭💋
0️⃣ back = your town 🏘️ stays a blue-BALLED 🔵 ghost 🏚️😭
🔟 back = lightning ⚡ strikes twice 🔂 and the paper-PUSSY 🐱 gets its massive 📦 relief load 💦💦💦
